localization.material_failure_definition: garment truncation, structural-detail loss, or interfering annotation

annotation.method: human-reviewed coarse spatial garment and handwriting localization
annotation.policy: Whiten outside the selected garment box and whiten every reviewed handwriting box. All geometrically overlapping cases require an ambiguity flag and explicit before/after visual approval.

approval_boundary: Frozen before any CLO-SKET DINOv2 embedding, classifier fit, or predictive outcome was computed.
